{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
assert 'new' in df['customer_segment'].unique(), "'new' customer segment is not present in data"
assert 'paid_search' in df['channel'].unique(), "'paid_search' channel is not present in data"
assert df['converted'].isin([0, 1]).all(), "'converted' column contains values other than 0 and 1"

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
if qa_mask.sum() > 0:
    print(f"Found {qa_mask.sum()} QA orders with revenue = 999999.99. These will be removed.")
else:
    print("No QA orders found.")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
if refunded_mask.sum() > 0:
    print(f"Found {refunded_mask.sum()} refunded orders. These will be excluded.")
else:
    print("No refunded orders found.")

# Check revenue format
print("Revenue column dtype:", df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Example of revenue:", df['revenue'].iloc[0])

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
